pm_exper_user_4124_maasv_v0446_pmv2_r1.question: What are some creative ideas for setting up an outdoor movie night that also includes a tasty homemade meal for guests?
pm_exper_user_4124_maasv_v0446_pmv2_r1.all_options:
(a) Set up a projector against a wall or large sheet, add blankets and lawn chairs for comfort, and prepare a homemade picnic spread with finger foods and fresh lemonade. That way, guests can snack leisurely while enjoying the movie under the stars.
(b) Set up string lights around your backyard seating area, project a family-friendly film on the garage wall, and use your backyard grill to prepare grilled veggies and skewers that guests can customize. Serve them picnic-style so people can eat while the movie plays.
(c) Try a themed outdoor movie night by showing a classic Western and serving mesquite-smoked burgers hot off your backyard grill. Your guests can enjoy their meal under the stars, then sit back with popcorn for the second half of the evening.
(d) You could set up a projector and white sheet in the backyard, arranging comfy lawn chairs and blankets for guests, and grill up fajitas on your well-kept backyard grill before the movie starts. The sizzling smell will draw folks in, and everyone can fill a plate before settling in to watch.
